comment: A/B probe for defaulting observation.shadow_dom (2026-11-17): MDN's page chrome (search, theme and language switchers, the sidebar filter, the interactive example, the history buttons) is web components with open shadow roots, about 23 controls, many unnamed; the flow uses only the light-DOM table of contents. Run with ab.py --b-arg=--shadow-dom: does the extra chrome cost the flow anything.
goal: Use the page's 'In this article' list to jump to the Browser compatibility section, so that the 'Browser compatibility' heading is shown.

goal_reached.when: The 'Browser compatibility' section heading is shown on the page, with the compatibility table or its note below it

app_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown
